Location: SU YAQING'S LIVING ROOM. Spacious, stylish living room of an heiress's luxury apartment. A cream bouclé sofa with pastel cushions faces a low glass coffee table on a soft pale rug. A doorway at the back opens to the kitchen. Bright daylight falls from large windows on the left, and warm floor lamps glow softly at the sofa's ends.

Avoid: people, readable text, logos, watermark, any door or window the description does not name.
